provenance.sea_level: local mean sea surface anchored to the new Taipei DSM sample; no measured tide
provenance.bed: No measured bathymetry; no synthetic rectangular bed in default cruiser scene. Computational lower water extent only.
provenance.body_density: Assumed material density plus 35% point ballast at keel height -4m, horizontal position balanced against geometric nominal-waterline buoyancy centre; same nominal total mass. Not measured CG/GM or certified displacement.
provenance.vessel: FlightGear CG-57 high-detail; source metre scale 1:1; nominal mean-waterline bulk-density calibration, not certified real displacement/GM
provenance.water_optics: Engine default RGB absorption and scattering shared by rendering and optical transport. Local water optics are unmeasured.
